description: Ministry of Defence - Award of Desha Puthra Sammanaya Year 2019  - Sri Lanka Naval Force
categorisation: This gazette announces the awarding of the Desha Puthra Sammanaya (a national honor/award) to a specific individual. While it involves a government action (by the President) and names a person, it does not fit Types 1-3 because it is not about government structural changes, personnel appointments/transfers, or portfolio assignments. It also does not fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) as it is not about land, legal/commercial matters, elections, public service, or judicial/law enforcement. This falls under national honors/awards, which is a miscellaneous administrative matter.
